correctness.rationale: For every measurable generator f in [0,1], the analytic proof establishes C_f copula iff h=k' >=0 a.e., with a nonnegative off-diagonal measure and singular diagonal density f. Marginal normalization and the exact identities p=int f and rho=3int t² f are verified. The upper mass-rearrangement comparison is pointwise nonnegative. The lower deficiency rho-p² is an exact sum of two nonnegative integrals; strict positivity away from a=sqrt(p) forces the unique lower generator, while mass rearrangement forces the unique upper. Convex combinations achieve all intermediate rho. Endpoint p=0,1 treated. Exact symbolic identities and rational construction examples passed in check.py; finite probes are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Exact matched-event mass and population rank concordance are two natural distinct dependence summaries in singular copula models. A complete sharp feasible region with unique extremizers and an exact nonnegative deficit answers a motivated structural identification question: p=1/4 allows rho from 1/16 to 37/64, a wide interval not obtainable from either separate formula alone. The result can guide construction and calibration of tied-observation copula models, without requiring a downstream theorem.
